pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark regions with jagged, multi-lobed perimeters and acute angles. Edges exhibit soft pixel gradients but maintain distinct spatial separation. Patch size decreases progressively from the mid-flank toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a dense topological grid. Junction nodes typically connect three to five pathways. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively wide and consistent across the central flank, narrowing slightly at the extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck. The mane texture appears as a semi-translucent fringe against the background pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-plumaged avian organism is perched on the dorsal ridge at the upper neck/shoulder junction, creating a localized silhouette disruption.
